transcript: Speaker A: पहले मुझे इंग्लिश के नाम पर सिर्फ और सिर्फ यस, नो और ओके बोलना आता था। [Earlier, in the name of English, I only knew how to say yes, no, and okay.] But now I can speak tough words like structure, description, destruction. और इंग्लिश सीखने के लिए ना ही मुझे कोई महंगा कोर्स करना पड़ा और ना ही किसी स्कूल से डिग्री लेनी पड़ी। [And to learn English, I neither had to do any expensive course nor did I have to get a degree from any school.] मैंने बस एक ऐप डाउनलोड करी, English Seekho App. [I just downloaded an app, English Seekho App.] English Seekho App पर एक AI कोच है जिससे रोज चैट करता हूं [There is an AI coach on English Seekho App with whom I chat daily] और एक महीने में ही मेरी इंग्लिश एकदम फ्लूएंट हो गई। [and in just one month, my English became completely fluent.] Now I feel confident in my English. अगर आपको भी फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश बोलना सीखना है तो अभी English Seekho App डाउनलोड कर लीजिए। [If you also want to learn to speak fluent English, then download the English Seekho App right now.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho App.]
on_screen_text:
7 din [7 days]
English Seekho Na Mehnga course Na college [Learn English, No expensive course, No college]
English Seekho App AI Coach Roz chat 1 Mahina Fluent [English Seekho App, AI Coach, Daily chat, 1 Month, Fluent]

summary: A young boy shares his testimonial of becoming fluent in English within a month using the English Seekho App's AI coach. He highlights that he achieved this without expensive courses or school degrees. The ad concludes with a call to action prompting viewers to install the app.
